note: Illustrative ranges compiled from 2026 third-party data (AIR Media-Tech, vidIQ, creatorblade, shorts/saturaai, flowshorts, projectcasting, creatorsjet, elev8or). Platform rates change constantly — verify live before making decisions. These are ranges, not promises.

facebook_content_monetization.fast_track_mar2026: $1,000/mo at 100K+ followers or $3,000/mo at 1M+ followers (IG/TikTok/YT count), US/Canada, 3-month cap, 15 original Reels/month across 10+ days (TechCrunch/PetaPixel Mar 2026)
facebook_content_monetization.note_2025: Meta paid ~$3B to creators in 2025 (+35% YoY, ~60% on Reels); Reels generated ~60% of payouts (socialbee Sep 2026)
facebook_content_monetization.rpm_note: Wide range; Reels often $0.02–$0.20. Instagram has NO standing Reels bonus (Reels Play ended 2023) — IG stack is brand deals, affiliates, subscriptions, invite-only bonuses (timetopost.co)
facebook_content_monetization.source: shortsync, socialbee, techcrunch, petapixel, timetopost.co, Oct 2026

tiktok_creator_rewards.eligibility: 10K followers + 100K video views in last 30 days + 18+ + personal account in good standing (kompozy Jul 2026, multilogin Sep 2026)
tiktok_creator_rewards.eligible_countries_note: Availability figures vary across sources (8–50+) — verify against creators.tiktok.com
tiktok_creator_rewards.rpm_note: Only videos over 1 minute with original content qualify; earning starts after 1,000 qualified For You views; paid monthly on the 15th at $50 balance. Payout = qualified views/1,000 x RPM + Additional Reward quality bonus
tiktok_creator_rewards.source: creatorblade.com Oct 11 2026, AIR Media-Tech Oct 10 2026, kompozy, multilogin
tiktok_creator_rewards.eligible_note: Mexico added 2026 (Hootsuite Oct 2026). Verify live in TikTok Studio.

tiktok_creator_rewards.us_payout_per_1000_qualified: $0.40-$1.00 (top-tier long-form US creators; AIR Media-Tech Oct 2026)

youtube_ypp_tier2_full.note_2027: CONFIRMED via fresh check Oct 11, 2026: YouTube announced Aug 10, 2026 — new applicants from Feb 1, 2027 need 1,000 subs + 8,000 qualified watch hours over 365 days OR 20M qualified Shorts views over 90 days (up from 4,000 hrs / 10M views). 1,000-sub floor unchanged; existing partners grandfathered; fan-funding tier unchanged. Multiple press: Cartoon Brew, Tech Times, Hypebeast, AIR Media-Tech, Music Business Worldwide.
youtube_ypp_tier2_full.source: YouTube Help Center via 1of10/air.io, Oct 2026; 2027 change confirmed via press Aug 2026
youtube_ypp_tier2_full.watch_time_gate_note: Thresholds are entry fees, not guarantees — watch-time is the real gate, and YouTube's Jan 2026 enforcement wave reportedly stripped tens of millions of subscribers from mass-produced/AI-content channels (medium.com Sep 2026, single source — flag)

revenue_splits.premium_lite_source_note: Premium Lite expands to every market where regular Premium is sold; 60% of net Premium Lite revenue funds the creator pool vs 30% of net regular Premium (AIR Media-Tech, Oct 2026).

sponsorship_rate_card_2026.disclaimer: Negotiation ranges, not quotes. Compiled 2026 agency benchmarks (air.io, projectcasting, creatorsjet, talentir) — benchmarks disagree 2-3x within tiers. Niche, engagement, format, and usage rights move numbers as much as follower count. Creators list rates ~23% above what they accept; 41% offer package discounts on 3+ posts.
sponsorship_rate_card_2026.holiday_2026_note: Black Friday brand deals can pay LESS per post than normal rates — brands buy in bulk during BFCM (Lilach Bullock, Oct 2026). Affiliate commissions are often cut during BFCM week because brand margins are thin from the discount itself. 2026 usage-rights benchmarks: paid ad usage 3 months +25-50%, 3-6 months +50-75%, 6-12 months +75-100%, perpetual from 2x base; whitelisting 30-100% of base fee per month (projectcasting 2026).

sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.integrated_vs_ad_rpm: An integrated YouTube sponsor slot pays $20–$35 per 1,000 views vs ~$2.30 median ad RPM (9–15x) — sponsorships dwarf platform payouts (air.io, Oct 10 2026)
sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.negotiation_note: Listed rates run ~23% above accepted rates — negotiate. Usage rights are the most-neglected line item: price paid-ad usage of your content SEPARATELY from the post fee (projectcasting.com, Sep 2026)
sponsorship_rule_of_thumb.note: Common starting point: $20–$50 per 1,000 expected views for a dedicated integration in mid-value niches; finance/tech 2–3x, entertainment lower. Negotiate on audience quality, not just views. Verify with current creator rate reports.

usage_rights_benchmarks_2026.source: projectcasting 2026 usage-rights benchmarks (via the wave-25 Q4 2026 research sweep); the same figures are carried in prose in sponsorship_rate_card_2026.holiday_2026_note
usage_rights_benchmarks_2026.note: Add-ons are percentages ON TOP of the base post fee, priced as separate line items — never folded into the post fee. Ranges, not quotes. Verify against current creator rate reports before quoting.

tiers.label: Organic only
tiers.note: Base post fee covers organic placement on your channel only — the absence of a line item, not a market rate.

tiers.label: Paid ads, 3 months
tiers.note: Brand re-runs your content as paid ads for 3 months.

tiers.label: Paid ads, 3-6 months
tiers.note: Brand re-runs your content as paid ads for 3-6 months.

tiers.label: Paid ads, 6-12 months
tiers.note: Brand re-runs your content as paid ads for 6-12 months. Cap it in writing.

tiers.label: Perpetual / unlimited
tiers.note: From 2x the base fee (add-on of +100% or more) — price as its OWN line item, or refuse. A perpetual paid-ads license turns your post into the brand's permanent ad creative.

usage_rights_benchmarks_2026.whitelisting_note: Whitelisting (ads run from YOUR account) is priced monthly, separately from the post fee — always revocable, never perpetual.

youtube_longform_rpm_source_note: Research pass Oct 11, 2026 (AIR Media-Tech / OutlierKit / UTubeKit / ytmoneycalculator): low RPM niches (gaming, entertainment) $1-$5; mid (education, lifestyle) $4-$10; high (finance, business) $8-$35 (~7x gap vs gaming/entertainment per OutlierKit); music $0.75-$1.65; kids content $0.33 RPM (~3M views to earn $1,000, AIR Media-Tech). Creator-reported/benchmark ranges, not YouTube-published rates. Monetized playbacks typically 60-85% of views. Q4 pays 40-80% more than Q1.

niche_growth_2026.source: Channel growth: AIR Media-Tech via TubeAI study of 144,370 YouTube channels (10K-100K subs), Sep 7-27, 2026; median across all channels 0.97%/mo. Search/outlier/breakout data: OutlierKit (Aug-Sep 2026). RPMs: AIR Media-Tech / OutlierKit / UTubeKit / Famety / upGrowth. All CPM/RPM are creator-reported and benchmark-estimated ranges, not YouTube-published; they vary by geography, season (Q4 spikes 30-50%), and audience tier. Ranges, not rates.

rpm_reality.kids_caveat: kids grew fastest (1.59%/mo) but pays worst: $0.33 RPM, ~3M views to earn $1,000 (AIR Media-Tech). Growth != revenue.
rpm_reality.gap_note: roughly a 7x gap per view between finance and gaming/entertainment (OutlierKit)

reality_checks: Fewer than 1% of YouTube channels ever reach 100K subscribers (Lilach Bullock, Oct 2026) — plan a business model around 10K-30K loyal subscribers, not a million.
Clipping/re-upload channels face channel-level reach reduction on Shorts from Oct 1, 2026 (announced by Creator Liaison Rene Ritchie).
YouTube's January 2026 inauthentic-content enforcement removed 16 major channels (4.7B combined views) and demonetized thousands of low-effort AI channels (UTubeKit).
